trans-unit.resname: PrestaShop brings 128

PrestaShop limits the name of a product to 128 characters, and that limit lives in three places at once: the column of the database, the validation of the product model and the field of the product page. This module raises the three.
trans-unit.source: PrestaShop limits the name of a product to 128 characters, and that limit lives in three places at once: the column of the database, the validation of the product model and the field of the product page. This module raises the three.
trans-unit.target: PrestaShop limita el nombre de un producto a 128 caracteres, y ese límite vive en tres sitios a la vez: la columna de la base de datos, la validación del modelo de producto y el campo de la ficha de producto. Este módulo sube los tres.

trans-unit.resname: Raises the product name limit from 128 characters to the length you choose, in the database and in the product page. The long name then shows up by itself in the cart, the order, the emails, the invoices and the tables.
trans-unit.source: Raises the product name limit from 128 characters to the length you choose, in the database and in the product page. The long name then shows up by itself in the cart, the order, the emails, the invoices and the tables.
trans-unit.target: Sube el límite del nombre del producto de 128 caracteres a los que elijas, en la base de datos y en la ficha de producto. El nombre largo sale entonces solo en el carrito, el pedido, los correos, las facturas y las tablas.

trans-unit.resname: Settings saved.
The Name field of the product page stops rejecting more than 128 characters.
trans-unit.source: The Name field of the product page stops rejecting more than 128 characters.
trans-unit.target: El campo Nombre de la ficha de producto deja de rechazar más de 128 caracteres.

trans-unit.resname: The button "Back to 128 characters" leaves the column as PrestaShop brings it. It refuses to do it while there are longer names, because they would be cut. Uninstalling the module does not shrink the column either: your names are safe.
trans-unit.source: The button "Back to 128 characters" leaves the column as PrestaShop brings it. It refuses to do it while there are longer names, because they would be cut. Uninstalling the module does not shrink the column either: your names are safe.
trans-unit.target: El botón «Volver a 128 caracteres» deja la columna como la trae PrestaShop. Se niega a hacerlo mientras haya nombres más largos, porque se cortarían. Desinstalar el módulo tampoco encoge la columna: tus nombres están a salvo.

trans-unit.resname: The column is the same for every shop: this setting is global.
trans-unit.source: The column is the same for every shop: this setting is global.
trans-unit.target: La columna es la misma para todas las tiendas: esta configuración es global.

trans-unit.resname: The column keeps the length it has now: your long names are not touched.
trans-unit.source: The column keeps the length it has now: your long names are not touched.
trans-unit.target: La columna se queda con la longitud que tiene ahora: tus nombres largos no se tocan.

trans-unit.resname: The column product_lang.name becomes as long as you set, and its index becomes a prefix index (a full index on a longer column does not fit in InnoDB).
trans-unit.source: The column product_lang.name becomes as long as you set, and its index becomes a prefix index (a full index on a longer column does not fit in InnoDB).
trans-unit.target: La columna product_lang.name pasa a la longitud que elijas, y su índice pasa a ser de prefijo (un índice completo sobre una columna más larga no cabe en InnoDB).

trans-unit.resname: The friendly URL
The friendly URL keeps its 128 characters: making it longer is bad for SEO and for the browsers. If it is built from a long name, the module cuts it at 128.
trans-unit.source: The friendly URL keeps its 128 characters: making it longer is bad for SEO and for the browsers. If it is built from a long name, the module cuts it at 128.
trans-unit.target: La URL amigable se queda con sus 128 caracteres: alargarla es malo para el SEO y para los navegadores. Si se genera a partir de un nombre largo, el módulo la corta en 128.
